instruction.name: vmulwod.d.wu
instruction.description: Multiply the odd-positioned unsigned 32-bit elements in `a` and the corresponding unsigned 32-bit elements in `b`, extending both to 64-bit, and save the 64-bit result in `dst`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Dependent vector-register chain with small positive integer element values.
